# v0.1.20

## 中文

### 自动巡检
- 支持「仅巡检已禁用账号」
- 对精确额度用尽（429）和强凭证失败（401）固定禁用；403/402 可按设置选择禁用或删除
- 可选「健康后自动恢复」：仅对已到期的精确额度用尽账号恢复

### 自动禁用号池
- 支持按分类解禁/删除，以及全部删除
- 后台执行可看进度、可停止

### 优化
- 降低「真实 429 被误标成 401」：裸 `Authentication required` 不再永久自动禁用；后续精确额度用尽可纠正误标 401
- 手机端自动禁用操作按钮（含「解禁 401 认证失败」长文案）改为整行显示，避免挤版

## English

### Scheduled inspection
- “Disabled accounts only”
- Exact free-usage 429 and strong credential 401 are always disabled; 403/402 follow the configured disable/delete action
- Optional “auto-recover when healthy”: only for exact free-usage accounts after cooldown has expired

### Autoban pool
- Unban/delete by category, and delete all
- Background progress with stop

### Improved
- Fewer free-usage accounts mislabeled as 401: bare `Authentication required` is no longer a permanent auto-ban; a later exact free-usage 429 can correct a prior unauthorized ban
- Mobile autoban action buttons use full-width layout so long category labels stay readable
